# The Moto Legion

> The Moto Legion is a southeast Michigan motorcycle creator crew: SpartanH2 (POV rides, group rides, bike nights, rider culture) and Zh.Who (Detroit biketok, street and strip, drag racing, 2022 Kawasaki Z H2). One crew. The shared Discord is where the rides get planned.

Content reflects personal riding experience. Not a paid dealer or sponsor endorsement unless explicitly stated.

## About

- [Home](https://themotolegion.com/): The Moto Legion hub: both creators' links, the latest TikTok drops from both accounts, and the Discord invite

## Members

- [SpartanH2](https://spartanh2.com/): Southeast Michigan motorcycle content creator. POV rides, group rides, bike nights, rider culture.
  - [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@spartan.h2)
  - [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/SpartanH2/)
  - [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@SpartanH2)
- [Zh.Who](https://zhwho.com/): Detroit biketok creator. Street and strip, drag racing, supercharged 2022 Kawasaki Z H2 build.
  - [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@zh.who)
  - [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/zh.who/)
  - [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@zhwho)

## Content types

- POV motorcycle riding footage across southeast Michigan and Detroit
- Group ride and bike night coverage
- Street and strip / drag racing content, Kawasaki Z H2 build progress
- Rider culture, community moments, and street-level storytelling

## Location

- Southeast Michigan / Detroit, United States

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/fz67hjDnPW): The Moto Legion rider community server, where group rides get planned
